title: Document Persistence, Autosave and Recovery
selected_by_owner: 2026-10-03 owner explicitly excluded AI writing for now and directed Continue into the next writing-system implementation tranche after CWKS-04.
objective: Make the shared CWKS document engine durable by persisting validated CreatorDocumentV1 documents through the existing provider-neutral local document store, adding autosave/recovery behavior, and failing safely on stale writes without absorbing story, wiki, collaboration, version-history, Creator Suite or AI-writing scope.

include: provider-neutral persistence adapter for validated CreatorDocumentV1 using packages/local-store
storage metadata kept outside CreatorDocumentV1 content and keyed without narrowing the canonical documentId contract
document load/create/save/delete behavior with local-store revision compare-and-set stale-write protection
autosave coordinator with explicit clean/dirty/saving/saved/conflict/error state
recovery journal/checkpoint that preserves unsaved document content across reload/crash boundaries
recovery detection and explicit restore/discard behavior without silently overwriting the last saved document
safe validation/fail-closed behavior for corrupt or unsupported stored/recovery payloads
focused CWKS-05 persistence/autosave/recovery tests plus Linux/Windows deterministic validation
exclude: named version history or revision browsing UI
comments, review annotations or multiplayer/collaborative editing
story project hierarchy, corkboard, storyboard, timeline or plot board
wiki backlinks, transclusion or knowledge graph
AI writing, generation or AI knowledge assistance
changes to GPR Session Service scope
